name: RiversMAN Mathematics Challenge
description: Annual mathematics competition organised by the Rivers State Mathematical Association (RiversMAN) for secondary school students across Rivers State. Tests algebra, geometry, statistics, and olympiad-level problem-solving across junior and senior divisions.

name: Cowbellpedia Secondary School Mathematics TV Quiz
description: Nigeria's premier mathematics television quiz competition, organised by Promasidor Nigeria Limited. Broadcast nationally on NTA and selected state television stations. Junior and senior categories. One of the most widely watched academic competitions in Nigeria.

name: STEM Olympics Pan-African Championship
description: Pan-African STEM competition bringing together secondary school students from over 20 African nations. Categories include robotics, coding challenge, mathematics relay, physics experiment design, and science communication. Hosted on a rotating country basis.

name: Nigerian Mathematical Olympiad
description: The official national mathematics olympiad that selects Nigeria's team for the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO). Run through a two-stage process: state-level preliminary rounds followed by a national final. Top performers represent Nigeria internationally.

name: Lagos State Inter-School Debate Championship
description: Annual parliamentary debate competition for secondary schools across Lagos State, organised by the Lagos State Ministry of Education. British Parliamentary format. Schools compete in both junior (JSS1–3) and senior (SSS1–3) divisions.

name: Kenya National Science Congress
description: Annual science fair and competition for Kenyan secondary school students organised by the Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC) and the Ministry of Education. Projects are evaluated in biology, chemistry, physics, and computer science categories.

name: Ghana National Science & Maths Quiz
description: Ghana's most prestigious secondary school academic competition, broadcast on GTV and Adom TV. Tests science (biology, chemistry, physics) and mathematics in a relay format. Organised by the Ghana Education Service. Nationally followed and highly competitive.

name: East African Schools Debate Championship
description: Annual competitive debate tournament bringing together secondary schools from Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, and Rwanda. World Schools Debate format. Host country rotates annually. Aims to build critical thinking and public speaking across East Africa.

name: International Science and Engineering Fair (ISEF)
description: The world's largest pre-college science competition, affiliated to Society for Science. Students win the right to attend by placing first or second at a qualifying affiliated fair. Categories include behavioural science, chemistry, engineering, environmental science, mathematics, and physics.

name: AMC 10/12 (American Mathematics Competition)
description: The AMC 10 and AMC 12 are the first competitions in the series of competitions leading to the USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO) and ultimately the IMO. Administered globally. High scorers advance to the AIME, then to USAMO/USAJMO.

name: DECA International Career Development Conference
description: DECA prepares emerging leaders and entrepreneurs in marketing, finance, hospitality and management. The ICDC is the global finals. Competitive events include written exams, role plays, and presentations judged by industry professionals.

name: Science Olympiad National Tournament
description: Science Olympiad is one of the premier science competitions in the US, providing rigorous, standards-based challenges. Each team of 15 members competes in 23 events covering biology, chemistry, physics, earth science, and engineering.

name: The Hague International Model United Nations (THIMUN)
description: One of the world's largest and oldest Model UN conferences, held annually in The Hague, Netherlands. Over 3,200 delegates from across the world. THIMUN is the affiliated body that accredits many school MUN programs globally.

name: Nigerian National Debate Championship
description: The premier national secondary schools debate competition in Nigeria, organised in partnership with the National Association of Debate Coaches (NADC). World Schools Debate format. State winners compete at the national level.

name: Pan-African Mathematics Olympiad (PAMO)
description: Organised under the African Mathematical Union (AMU), PAMO is the African counterpart of the IMO. Countries submit teams of up to six students who compete in a two-day written examination. Results feed into IMO team selections for many African nations.
